About DiffComoSVC

DiffComoSVC uses a consistency-distilled diffusion model for singing voice conversion. It combines the quality of diffusion-based methods with faster inference by using consistency training, allowing high-fidelity voice conversion in fewer steps.

How to use:

  1. Upload the song you want to convert as Content Audio — isolated vocals without background music work best.
  2. Upload a sample of the target singer's voice as Reference Audio — 5-15 seconds is enough.
  3. Click Convert Singing Voice and wait for the result.

Requires a pre-trained DiffComoSVC checkpoint. Contact the project maintainer if the model is not loaded.
